narr: A deep mid-level trough and associated cold front approached from the west on the 16th. Ahead of the trough/front, surface dewpoints in the 60s spread into central North Carolina, with strong low-level and deep-layer shear. Two rounds of severe weather occurred from mid morning through the evening hours. Several reports of damaging winds and large hail were reported, along with isolated flash flooding.
ev: A stranded vehicle was reported due to flooding on Hoyle Dr in northeast Raleigh.
Pigeon House Branch exceeded its flood stage of 12ft at 10:25 PM, resulting in minor flood at Capital Blvd and Fenton St.
